note: Historical nested walk-forward test of whether D1 technical state can forecast path/risk/execution variables. Model and pair/bandwidth selection use prior data only. Feature-pair menu was researched previously, so passing results are Shadow evidence, not pristine independent forward confirmation and must not modify Frozen V4 MAIN automatically.

continuous_targets.time_to_mfe10: trading days to first T+10 maximum high
continuous_targets.time_to_mae10: trading days to first T+10 minimum low

method.hold_target: choose best expected endpoint among T+1/T+3/T+5/T+10; score by reduction in realized regret versus train-only baseline hold
method.surface: 2D Gaussian kernel in train-only empirical-percentile space
method.outer_fold: calendar-year expanding walk-forward with 10-session boundary gap
method.selector: pair+bandwidth chosen using earlier walk-forward years only
method.inference: one-sided Newey-West/HAC on event-level squared-error or regret improvement; BH-FDR across all 18 index×target tests
